title: AI代理能否综合科学结论？
summary: 引入SciConBench基准测试，评估AI代理综合科学结论的能力。发现最佳代理在受控环境下F1分数仅0.337，且无约束评估会高估能力。消费者代理常生成不完整或矛盾结论，表明可靠综合仍是挑战。
summary_en: Introduces SciConBench, a benchmark for evaluating AI agents' ability to synthesize scientific conclusions. Finds best agent achieves only 0.337 F1 in clean-room settings; unconstrained evaluation inflates capabilities. Consumer agents often produce incomplete or contradictory conclusions, showing reliable synthesis remains an open challenge.
